sources.title: GitHub - Qengineering/Qwen3.5-0.8B-NPU: Qwen3.5-VL-0.8B on the RK3588 ...
sources.snippet: Once converted to RKNN, parts of the model can run on the NPU, improving speed. Despite these limits, models like Qwen3-2B run well on the RK3588 because the NPU efficiently accelerates the heavy math, and the vision encoder can be optimised. This makes advanced multimodal AI feasible on small, power-efficient devices.

sources.title: Run & Benchmark Qwen3.5 0.8B: Smallest Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.
